items.item_text: 01. All applicants are required to submit responses to the following supplemental questions. Your responses will provide information about your background and experience related to this position and will be used in the screening and selection process. Be concise yet specific and informative in your responses to these supplemental questions. "See resume," attachments or links will not be accepted as a substitute for your responses to the questions in the following boxes. Incomplete responses will not be considered. Please indicate below that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes | No

02. I understand that my application will be considered incomplete if any required sections of the application are not completed and/or if any documents that are required are not attached to my online application by the closing date. Options: Yes | No
03. Please indicate your highest level of education: Options: Some High School | High school diploma or equivalent | Some College | Associates Degree | Bachelors Degree | Masters Degree | Doctorate
04. Do you possess a Registered Nurse (RN) licensure or other clinical credential in a nursing or allied health discipline. Options: Yes | No
05. Do you possess a Certified Healthcare Simulation Operations Specialist (CHSOS) credential issued by the Society for Simulation in Healthcare (SSH)? Options: Yes | No

06. How many years of experience do you have working in clinical simulation, healthcare education, or laboratory operations. Options: None | One year | Two years | Three years | Four years | Five years | +Six years

07. Indicate where you have worked to obtain experience in clinical simulation, healthcare education, or laboratory operations. What was the time frame? What was the employer's name? Describe the work performed. This section is required.

08. Describe how you have demonstrated sensitivity and understanding in delivery of services and support to a diverse workforce and student population (diverse in terms of socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic background). This section is required.
Certified Healthcare Simulation Operations Specialist (CHSOS) credential issued by the Society for Simulation in Healthcare (SSH), required at time of hire
Associate degree from an accredited institution in nursing, health science, healthcare administration, education, or a closely related field
Bachelor's degree in nursing, health science, healthcare administration, education, or a closely related field
Three (3) years of progressively responsible experience in clinical simulation, healthcare education, or laboratory operations

Serves as the program lead for the Health Sciences Simulation Lab; develops, implements, and evaluates an annual simulation operations plan, scenario library, and equipment lifecycle and replacement plan in consultation with the Dean of Health Sciences and health sciences faculty; completes operational priorities, standards, and workflows for all simulation lab functions.

Maintains direct, hands-on operational proficiency with high- and low-fidelity simulation mannequins, task trainers, simulation software platforms, and audiovisual control-room systems; provides technical coverage during peak instructional periods to ensure continuity of simulation-based instruction.

Partners with nursing and allied health faculty and contributes simulation-design expertise to course-level learning outcomes, scenario development, debriefing frameworks, and formative and summative assessment structures in alignment with accreditation expectations.

Works with management and develops, implements, and maintains the simulation lab’s safety, infection-control, and biohazard management program in alignment with Cal/OSHA, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), and Society for Simulation in Healthcare (SSH) standards; serves as the program’s point of contact for Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) audits, regulatory inspections, and corrective action plans.

Serves as a point of contact for accreditation reviews and processes related to simulation resource adequacy; prepares supporting documentation, conducts self-assessments, and coordinates response to accreditor findings.

Monitors the simulation lab’s annual operating and equipment budget; identifies and recommends capital equipment needs and grant-funded acquisition opportunities, including Perkins V, Hispanic-Serving Institutions - Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (HSI-STEM), and other applicable categorical funding sources; analyzes expenditure trends and prepares fiscal reports for the Dean.

Manages vendor service and maintenance contracts; initiates procurement requisitions for simulation equipment, supplies, and consumables; evaluates vendor performance and recommends contract renewals or replacements.
Registered Nurse (RN) licensure or other clinical credential in a nursing or allied health discipline

Vendor Relations

Technical Simulation Operations Proficiency
If you do not follow the process or your application/resume is incomplete, your information will not be processed.

If you need to update any submitted information, you will need to reapply in full. When HR sees duplicate applications, we archive the oldest and the most recent application and materials are considered.

The selection advisory committee will review, evaluate, and consider applications and supporting materials received by the deadline. Meeting the minimum qualifications for a particular position does not assure the applicant an interview.
While the acceptance of the application packet is done through PCC’s Applicant Tracking System (ATS), all hiring decisions are made by a hiring committee.

Once applications are submitted, they are final. Please carefully review your application and the documents which you are attaching to make sure that they are free from errors and complete. If you require assistance with your application, please refer to the application guide or you may contact NeoEd Customer Support at 855-524-5627. Customer Support is available Monday – Friday, 6 a.m. – 6 p.m. (PST).
Resume or Curriculum Vitae
Cover Letter
Successful applicants must provide proof of eligibility to work in the United States.
Successful completion of background check including Live Scan and Tuberculosis (TB) assessment/screening.
Pasadena Area Community College District will not sponsor any visa applications.
Applicants must be available for interviews at Pasadena City College at no cost to the District.
Applicants who have disabilities may request that accommodations be made in order to complete the selection process by contacting the Office of Human Resources directly at (626) 585-7388.
Crime awareness and campus security information are available from Campus Police. (Public Law 101-542).
The Pasadena Area Community College District is an equal opportunity employer. The District encourages applications from underrepresented minorities and the disabled.

An applicant, who attempts to contact individual Board members or members of the screening committee with the intent of influencing the decision of the committee or the Board, will be disqualified. General inquiries regarding the position and/or District employment should be directed to the Office of Human Resources.
